key_insight: Adding reason tags to trajectory preferences helps an RL reward model capture both human choices and their underlying rationale.
engineering_relevance: Combining learned human rewards with environment rewards can support task-effective agent behavior that better reflects human expectations and safety preferences.
method: Collect trajectory-level preference labels and reason tags.
Learn a human reward model using both feedback types.
Optimize the policy with combined human and environment rewards.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved interpretability versus preference-only reward learning but provides no datasets, benchmarks, or quantitative results.
watch_item: Implementation must balance human and environment rewards, and reason-tag collection adds annotation requirements.
paper_title: Reason-guided Human Reward Modeling for Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
